characters.name: REIN
characters.description: Väike oranz rebane, suurte kohevate sabaga, kandmas väikest sinist särki. Sõbralik ja uudishimulik näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JOONAS
characters.description: Väike hall jänes, pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest rohelist vesti. Rõõmsameelne ja energiline näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kevadine Aas
locations.description: A bright and sunny spring meadow. The grass is vibrant green with small scattered wildflowers like daisies and buttercups. In the background, there's a gentle slope leading to a lush green forest edge with tall, leafy trees. The sky is clear blue with soft white clouds. A few smooth grey stones are visible on the grass. The overall atmosphere is cheerful and inviting. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Rein, a small orange fox wearing a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit wearing a green vest, are sitting side-by-side on the vibrant green grass of a sunny spring meadow. They are looking at each other and smiling happily. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. The lush green forest edge is visible in the background under a clear blue sky. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are still sitting together on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. They both have thoughtful, curious expressions, looking slightly upwards as if contemplating an idea. The meadow has small scattered wildflowers, and the forest edge is in the background. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are standing up on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. They are facing each other, looking excited and animated, with big smiles. Joonas is gesturing with his paws as if sharing an idea. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. The forest edge is visible in the background. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are walking happily through the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. They are walking towards the lush green forest edge in the background. Small scattered wildflowers are visible on the grass around them. They both have joyful, exploring expressions. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are standing still in the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow near the forest edge. They are both tilting their heads slightly, with attentive expressions, listening intently. Their eyes are looking up towards the trees. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, is kneeling on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. He is holding two smooth grey stones in his paws, looking at them with a curious smile. Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, stands beside him, looking on with interest. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. The forest edge is in the background. Cartoon style.

Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, is now kneeling on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. He is holding two small, thin wooden sticks in his paws, smiling proudly. Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, kneels beside him, looking at the sticks with an excited expression. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. The forest edge is in the background. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are sitting on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. Rein is holding two smooth grey stones, and Joonas is holding two small wooden sticks. Joonas is gently tapping the sticks against the stones, and Rein is smiling, enjoying the sound. Small scattered wildflowers are around them. The forest edge is in the background. Cartoon style.

Rein, a small orange fox in a blue shirt, and Joonas, a small grey rabbit in a green vest, are sitting joyfully on the vibrant green grass of the sunny spring meadow. Rein is holding the two smooth grey stones, and Joonas is holding the two small wooden sticks. They are both happily making sounds together, tapping the stones and sticks, with big cheerful smiles on their faces. Small musical notes float in the air around them. Small scattered wildflowers and the forest edge complete the scene. Cartoon style.
